intro: Witch Doctor Uzer'i calls this the last job and sends you northwest to find the final enemy: mountain giants, whose size and strength Uzer'i is eager to harness.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The last task I will require of you is to travel to the northwest and find the final enemy.

The mountain giants left the mountains to aid the night elves when the burning legion appeared in the world. You will know them by their massive size and the way the ground begins to shake as you travel along their rocky terrain.
I am eager to harness power of that size. Kill 7 mountain giants, then use the muisek vessel to capture their powerful muisek.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to capture the mountain giants?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Just imagine the possibilities of what we now possess, friend. Along with the materials that you have collected, I will be able to forever trap the muisek of these creatures into whatever I wish.
